title: Import report: counts and a field-by-field sample
goal: The import can be checked against NERV's side by counts and a sample
acceptance: After an import, a read-only report gives per-table counts and a chosen sample of records field by field, keyed by both ids, so nerv:F-101-T08 can compare them with NERV's; specs on the fixture; the report holds owner data and is never written into the repository
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Owner data, export files and ID maps never enter Git

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: a read-only report over the import's ID map. Not a measurement.
